name: 02568 · Vineyard Hvn, MA
findings: ZIP 02568 (Vineyard Hvn) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02568 (Vineyard Hvn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
